attributes.action: Raise the age of consent to 18
attributes.background: The age of consent should be raised from 16 to 18 to provide greater protection for young people against grooming, manipulation and sexual exploitation by adults, recognising the significant differences in maturity, experience and power.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Raise the Age of Consent to 18 in England and Wales https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/784651
